entries.6d7210bcec989457: For fiscal 2026, the final year of the medium-term management plan "PLAN2026" (covering fiscal 2024 to fiscal 2026), the company sets as its priority goal "balancing investment for the future with achieving the PLAN2026 numerical targets," and states that it is working on "growth strategy," "strategic foundation" and "strategic execution capability" as its pillars, and focusing on laying the groundwork for the next medium-term management plan "PLAN2029." Under the growth strategy, the company states that it is working on promoting DX in design and manufacturing sites, advancing the development of wireless train control equipment for regional rail lines and the release of train detection equipment (axle counters), and preparing the ground for expanding sales in overseas markets.
